issues.message: Android package name must be approved and non-placeholder.
Application version must be approved and non-placeholder.
NODE_ENV must be production.
The mobile build profile must be production.
Test login must be explicitly disabled in production.
Pixel Lock fixture mode must be explicitly disabled in production.
Development authentication must be explicitly disabled.
Approved legal operator information is required.
PRIVACY_POLICY_URL must be an approved HTTPS URL.
TERMS_URL must be an approved HTTPS URL.
SUPPORT_URL must be an approved HTTPS URL.
STATUS_PAGE_URL must be an approved HTTPS URL.
EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL must be an approved HTTPS URL.
A valid Redis URL is required for queues and distributed protection.
S3_ENDPOINT must be an approved HTTPS URL.
S3_BUCKET must be production-managed.
S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID must be production-managed.
S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY must be production-managed.
Production Kakao client ID is required.
Kakao redirects must include the approved exact app callback and no insecure URL.
FEATURE_ANALYTICS_DEFAULT must default to false for production release.
FEATURE_AFFILIATE_DEFAULT must default to false for production release.
FEATURE_IMPORT_DEFAULT must default to false for production release.
FEATURE_NOTIFICATION_DEFAULT must default to false for production release.
Analytics consent must default to false.
A production affiliate domain allowlist is required.
ANDROID_SIGNING_KEYSTORE_PATH must reference externally managed signing material.
ANDROID_SIGNING_KEY_ALIAS must reference externally managed signing material.
ANDROID_SIGNING_STORE_PASSWORD_ENV must reference externally managed signing material.
ANDROID_SIGNING_KEY_PASSWORD_ENV must reference externally managed signing material.
Expected migration head must equal the repository migration head.
Generated contract drift check must pass.
JWT_ACCESS_SECRET must be injected from production secret storage.
JWT_REFRESH_SECRET must be injected from production secret storage.
AFFILIATE_CLICK_IP_SALT must be injected from production secret storage.
ANALYTICS_ANON_SALT must be injected from production secret storage.
PRIVACY_STATUS_TOKEN_SECRET must be injected from production secret storage.
PRIVACY_HASH_SALT must be injected from production secret storage.
DEVICE_ID_HASH_SALT must be injected from production secret storage.
RATE_LIMIT_KEY_SALT must be injected from production secret storage.
INTERNAL_METRICS_TOKEN must be injected from production secret storage.
Production OAuth adapter must be http.
Production queue adapter must be redis.
Production object storage adapter must be s3-compatible.
Production privacy processor mode must be live.
Production notification provider mode must be live.
